lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Hi everyone, I'm Liam, your host today.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Students have their AI.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Teachers have theirs.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: And the two never meet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: So let us introduce you to Bluestift: the platform where they finally do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Bluestift is a collaborative platform, built around Raya, the AI we designed for learning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Students learn, fail, challenge themselves, and find out exactly where they're stuck.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And not just on their own: their school gets the whole picture too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So they don't just learn more easily.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They learn better.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Here's a quick look at Raya, which is more than an AI: it's a platform of its own.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And you can try it right now, without an account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask Raya anything from your dashboard.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Instead of handing you the answer, Raya helps you find it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It checks facts on Wikipedia, draws your graphs, and works through the maths with you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Explore your learning in My Kernel, and see exactly why you're stuck.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Turn a lesson, a topic or a chat into quizzes, flashcards and mind maps, and practise your way.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Or even better, open a Study Room with your friends, to chat, share your documents and challenge each other, with Raya right there, always ready to help.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And while you learn, you're never on your own.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your school has your back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: With Bluestift Schools, your teachers see exactly where you're stuck, concept by concept.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Never your conversations.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They can tell Raya where to focus and how to help, and ask Raya about their class in return.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They set homework in minutes, get a clear report on every student, and a summary for the whole school.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So they can stay close to what matters most: the students who count on them every day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: All of this runs on one layer, built just for it: the Kernel.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With every attempt, it measures what you know, how fast you're moving, what really sticks, and your mindset.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So when Raya guides you, it's toward a problem the Kernel actually found.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not generic advice, and not a guess.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Like a physics mistake that really comes from a gap in maths.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And the best part: the Kernel grows with you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It assumes nothing, except that every student matters more than any grade.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Bluestift isn't just an AI tool, it's a whole ecosystem.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the people in it stay in control.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You can start without an email: a recovery key brings you back in, and you can replace it anytime.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No ads, and we never sell your data.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Analytics only runs if you say yes, and never for anyone under eighteen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing a minor writes is ever used for training, and adults decide with a single switch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Download everything, or delete your account, whenever you want.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And every third party we use is listed publicly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So that was a quick look at Bluestift.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you for watching.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We hope it helped you see how it all fits together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: To learn more, visit thebluestift.com, or just ask Raya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Now jump aboard, enjoy, and welcome to Bluestift!
